widgets.label: How dashboards work
widgets.value: Each registered chat on a Pro cluster can publish one dashboard. When the chat posts new results, Gent Desktop shows them across the cluster.

widgets.label: Ask a registered chat to build your dashboard
widgets.value: Make a Gent dashboard for this test run. Show how many tests have passed and list any failures.

widgets.label: Then ask it for updates
widgets.value: Update my dashboard after each test batch.
